sections.title: Train on a Mac (Apple Silicon)
sections.blurb: Everything here runs on a MacBook with 16 GB. This is what the Flisk model was trained with.

items.what: Fine-tune (LoRA, QLoRA, DoRA), fuse, quantize and serve LLMs on Apple Silicon. The tool behind the worked example below.
The array framework under it: NumPy-like, runs on the Mac GPU with unified memory.
Worked examples for MLX, from text generation to fine-tuning.

sections.title: Fine-tuning libraries
sections.blurb: Pick one. They all do LoRA/QLoRA; they differ in speed, memory use and how much they hide.

items.what: Fast, low-memory LoRA training with free Colab and Kaggle notebooks.
The standard library for LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods.
Supervised fine-tuning plus preference methods (DPO and friends) on top of PEFT.
Config-file driven fine-tuning of many models, single GPU to multi-GPU.
A broad fine-tuning toolkit with a web UI, for many model families.
PyTorch-native, readable fine-tuning recipes.

sections.title: Run, quantize and serve
sections.blurb: Turning a trained model into something people can call.

items.what: Run models on CPU and GPU, convert to GGUF, quantize, and constrain output with grammars.
One-command local model server with an OpenAI-compatible API and a Modelfile format.
High-throughput GPU serving engine.

sections.title: Make the output valid
sections.blurb: For structured answers such as JSON or config files, force the output to match a schema instead of hoping.

items.what: Structured generation: constrain a model to a JSON schema, regex or grammar.
Fast constrained decoding engine used by several serving stacks.
Efficient grammar-constrained decoding for LLM serving.

sections.title: Test your model
sections.blurb: A model you cannot measure is a model you cannot improve.

items.what: The standard harness for benchmarking language models.
Lightweight evaluation toolkit from Hugging Face.
Load, share and process datasets of any size.
Build synthetic datasets and feedback pipelines for fine-tuning.

sections.title: Small open models with a clear licence
sections.blurb: Licence column is read from each model's own card. Check it before you sell anything built on a model.

items.what: Small coding model. Fine-tuned in the worked example below.
Larger coding sibling.
The middle size. Note its licence is different from the other two.
Small general model built for on-device use.
Small reasoning-leaning model from Microsoft.
The simplest, fastest repo for training and fine-tuning medium-sized GPTs.
Build a GPT-style model step by step, with code and explanations.
